name: Asa Okitara Bishoujo ni Natteta Boku ni Onegai ga Arundatte? Shouganai nyaa.. Ii yo.
original_name: 朝起きたら美少女になってたボクにお願いがあるんだって？しょうがないにゃあ・・いいよ。
source:
We're just three guys, fooling around and playing games at my place. Our days are supposed to be nice and peaceful, but then...

"I woke up to discover I'd turned into a pretty girl!"

It's apparently a disease called "TS" and I have to live as a girl from now on. Fortunately, it's summer vacation. Let's leave school and future stuff aside for the time being, and enjoy the new TS bishoujo life until I can get used to it!

I'm the positive TS bishoujo Towa! I love anything cute! 
Here's my childhood friend Jin. Me as a TS girl is exactly his type!?
Here's my close friend Alma, who has an extraordinary liking towards me. Perhaps he is obsessed with me?

TS girl and two male friends. Same place, summer vacation. Well, nothing could happen, right?

[Translated from [url=https://dlsoft.dmm.co.jp/detail/inheart_0154/]DMM[/url]]
translation:
我们就三个人，在我家闲逛、玩游戏。我们的日子本来应该是美好而平静的，但是……

“我一觉醒来，发现自己变成了一个漂亮的女孩！”

这显然是一种叫做“TS”的疾病，从现在开始我必须像女孩一样生活。幸运的是，现在是暑假。暂时把学业和以后的事情抛在一边，享受新的TS美少女生活吧，直到我习惯为止！

我是正宗的TS美少女东和！我喜欢一切可爱的东西！
这是我儿时的朋友金。我这个TS妹子正是他喜欢的类型！？
这是我的好朋友阿尔玛，她对我非常喜欢。也许他对我着迷？

TS女孩和两个男性朋友。同一个地方，暑假。嗯，不会有什么事情发生吧？

[译自[url=https://dlsoft.dmm.co.jp/detail/inheart_0154/]DMM[/url]]
